en.headline: Bar staff charged after man found dead on Tsim Sha Tsui street
en.dek: A 28-year-old staff member was arrested for illegally handling a corpse after police say he and a woman moved a 48-year-old man from a bar toilet and left him on a chair outside.
body: Police arrested a 28-year-old bar staff member early on Thursday after a 48-year-old man was found dead on a chair outside a commercial building in Tsim Sha Tsui and charged him with illegally handling a corpse.

Officers received a report at about 1.38 am of an unconscious man outside 1 Hanoi Road near K11 Art Mall. Paramedics confirmed he was dead at the scene. The caller initially claimed he had found the man in a nearby shopping-mall toilet and carried him downstairs out of kindness.

Under further questioning the man admitted he worked at a bar on the seventh floor of a building at 25-31 Carnarvon Road. He said he discovered the victim unconscious in the bar toilet and, together with a Chinese woman believed to be a friend of the deceased, moved the body downstairs on a chair so the bar’s operations would not be disrupted. The woman left; the staff member placed the body on a chair across the street and then called police while posing as a passer-by.

Police entered the empty bar, whose door was ajar, and found bloodstains and drug paraphernalia including an ice pipe in the toilet. Suspected injection marks were noted on the dead man’s thigh. Officers are treating the death as a suspected drug overdose pending autopsy results and are searching for the woman, described as aged about 30 to 40. The case is being handled by the Yau Tsim District Crime Squad. The bar’s liquor licence was due to expire on Friday.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀酒吧男子倒斃街頭 職員涉非法搬移屍體被捕
zh.dek: 警方凌晨接報發現48歲男子坐在河內道商廈外椅上已死，28歲酒吧職員承認與女子合力將人從廁所抬出，現被控非法搬移屍體，警方正追緝涉案女子。
body: 警方周四凌晨約1時38分接報，指尖沙咀河內道1號附近電單車位有一名男子昏迷，救護員到場證實48歲姓黎男子已經死亡。報案的28歲姓吳男子初時稱在附近商場廁所發現事主，出於好心將他抬下樓。
經盤問後，吳男承認自己是加拿分道25至31號一幢商廈7樓酒吧的職員，今晨在酒吧廁所發現事主失去知覺。他與一名約30至40歲中國籍女子合力用椅子將事主抬到電梯大堂再下樓，女子其後離開，吳男則將事主棄置於對面街電單車位並報警。
警員登上涉事酒吧，大門虛掩，內裏無人。人員在廁所發現血跡及懷疑吸毒工具，包括冰壺。死者大腿有疑似針孔，警方初步不排除注射過量毒品致死，案件交由油尖警區重案組跟進，正通緝涉案女子。涉事酒吧酒牌原定周五到期。
